_about: Everything Parallax Analyst knows about the product version it is attached to (KSSL_Deploy v2). The client is data: {client_name}, {client_short} and {client_sector} are filled from the database, and the companies come from the data ("companies": "from_data"). To port to a new version, edit this folder (see ../PORTING.md) and run ../check_product.py.

client.name: {client_name}
client.brief: 137Parallax is a competitive-intelligence platform built for {client_name} ({client_sector}, {client_country}). Its users are {client_short}'s commercial and strategy team. The platform has three pillars: Competitive (rival signals, competitor profiles, competitor movements, products, product evaluation, partnerships, competitor projects, geo footprint, patents), Market (top opportunities, tenders, global requirements, market intelligence and past awards) and Technology (technology developments and innovations in the sector).
client.scope: {client_name}'s competitors and their products, specifications, partnerships, sites, projects, patents, leadership and news; tenders, global requirements and contract awards; technology developments in the {client_sector} sector
client.page_content: company profiles (company details, leadership, news), competitor movements (dated moves with what they mean and a read by view), product portfolios with specifications, features and programs, product evaluations (matchup verdicts and analytics), partner and alliance networks, competitor projects, geo footprint by country, patent portfolios, tender assessments (requirements, fit, competitor fit, eligibility, expected revenue, next steps), top opportunities and next moves, global requirements, intelligence signals, technology developments and past awards
client.answer_examples: a company's leadership, what a competitor's latest move means for {client_short}, a product's specifications, what a rival is building or pursuing (its projects), its patent portfolio, a tender's fit and next steps, a product evaluation verdict, what a signal means for {client_short}, a technology development
client.single_item_kinds: one company, product, tender, matchup, project, patent portfolio, signal or technology
client.data_summary: {competitors} tracked competitors; products ({products}) with specifications, head-to-head matchups ({matchups}), tenders ({tenders}) with fit, competitor fit and eligibility, global requirements and opportunities, contract awards ({awards}), partnerships ({partnerships}), footprint rows ({sites}), competitor projects ({projects}), patent filings ({patents}), leaders ({leaders}), news and competitor movements ({news}), intelligence signals ({signals}) and technology developments ({innovations}).
client.data_limits: Known gaps in the data: there is no market-share or sales-volume data. Patent filings are the tracked rivals' filings, not a full IP census. Most tender notices publish no value, and revenue figures for {client_short} are analyst estimates. Amounts are stored in their own currency; INR figures exist only where an official exchange rate is stored.
data_rules: About competitors: exclude the client (NOT is_client). Comparing {client_short} with rivals: include the client and keep is_client or the company name so it can be highlighted.
Filter text with the exact values listed in the catalogue, or ILIKE. Ids are text: compare them as text.
Money: amounts are in their own currency (value_currency / currency). Sum per currency and never across currencies; use value_inr only where it is not NULL, and say it uses the stored official rate.
Specifications are rows (product_spec, matchup_spec): match spec labels with ILIKE, and compare like with like (same category and subcategory).
client.gap_rule: When asked for market share, build the best proxy the data supports (presence by country, partnerships, products per category, tender competitor fit, award winners) and say it is a proxy.
client.guard_topics: their products, specifications and categories; tenders, global requirements, contract awards, buyers and segments; partnerships, sites, projects, patents and leadership; news, competitor movements and intelligence signals; technology developments in the {client_sector} sector; the markets {client_short} sells into
off_topic_suggestions: Which competitors are named most often as able to bid on open tenders?
Which rivals file the most patents, and in which technology areas?
client.refusal: I can't help with that one. Ask me about competitors, products, tenders, patents or awards.

database.companies_sql: SELECT comp_id, name, is_client, stance FROM company ORDER BY is_client DESC, sort_order
database.id_columns: comp_id, product_id, tender_id and title, matchup_id, signal_id, area_id

facts.client_name: SELECT name FROM company WHERE is_client LIMIT 1
facts.client_short: SELECT coalesce(short_name, name) FROM company WHERE is_client LIMIT 1
facts.client_sector: SELECT coalesce(sectors, 'competitive intelligence') FROM company WHERE is_client LIMIT 1
facts.client_country: SELECT coalesce(home_country, '') FROM company WHERE is_client LIMIT 1
facts.competitors: SELECT count(*) FROM company WHERE NOT is_client
facts.first_rival: SELECT name FROM company WHERE NOT is_client ORDER BY sort_order LIMIT 1

pages.label: Competitive Intelligence: the rival signal feed; a card opens its detail panel
Competitor Profile: one company's details, leadership and news
Competitor Movement: each rival's dated moves, what changed, the story so far, what it means for the client and a read by view
blocks: What changed since the previous move

pages.label: Products: a company's catalogue; a product opens with description, specifications, features, programs and news
Product Evaluation: head-to-head matchups, rival product vs the client's, with verdict, analytics and spec comparison
Partnership: each competitor's alliance network (suppliers, licences, JVs, technology partners) and overlaps with the client
Projects: what each competitor is building, supplying or pursuing, with stage, timeline and assessment
Geo Footprint: presence by company and country on a map, with overlaps, anomalies and white space
Patent: each rival's patent portfolio, and filings by technology field
Top opportunity: top tenders, projects to win before they tender and next moves; a market signal opens its detail panel
blocks: Projects to win before they tender

pages.label: Tenders: the tender list with each tender's fit assessment

payload.cat: filter the list to a category (analytics.tender.segment), optional
payload.country: filter the list to a country, optional

pages.label: Global Requirements: requirements and demand signals worldwide
Market Intelligence: market outlook (activity by segment, who wins, repeat buyers, drivers), active tenders, by category, awarded (past awards), closed
Technology Knowledge: the technology signal feed
Innovation Pipeline: developments by technology area

click_targets: company -> competitive / profile, payload_key cid, field comp_id
company products -> competitive / products, payload_key cid, field comp_id
company patents -> competitive / patents-comp, payload_key cid, field comp_id
tender -> market / tender, payload_key tenderTitle, field title
matchup -> competitive / positioning, payload_key matchupId, field matchup_id

tools.search_covers: company details, leadership, news; competitor movements; products with specifications and programs; product evaluations (matchup verdicts); partner networks; competitor projects; geo footprint; patent portfolios; tender assessments; top opportunities and next moves; global requirements; intelligence signals; technology developments; past awards
tools.focus_examples: 'Leadership', 'Company Details', 'Tender Assessment', 'Top tenders', 'Past awards', a tender title or a product name
